record_finding.description: Persist one project finding into the durable session log so later turns (and later processes) can read it. Use it only for a claim about this project. New findings start as status "open" with provenance "model-claim"; advance an existing finding by passing its findingId plus tool evidence. The record never enters the chat surface.
record_finding.parameters: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"claim":{"type":"string","description":"One-sentence claim about the project."},"findingId":{"type":"string","description":"Existing finding id (e.g. \"f-001\") when advancing a finding. Omit to create a new one."},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["open","confirmed","refuted","resolved"],"description":"New findings must be \"open\"; later states require findingId and tool evidence."},"provenance":{"type":"string","enum":["model-claim","tool-evidenced"],"description":"\"model-claim\" for a hypothesis; \"tool-evidenced\" only when real tool evidence exists."},"evidence":{"type":"array","description":"Evidence entries referencing real events of this session.","items":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["tool-result","file"]},"seq":{"type":"number","description":"Event seq in this session log."},"callId":{"type":"string","description":"Tool call id for tool-result evidence."},"path":{"type":"string","description":"File path for file evidence."}},"required":["kind","seq"]}}},"required":["claim"]}

search_memory.description: Search your own persisted findings about this project, using whatever words describe what you are trying to remember. Returns candidates only — id, a short excerpt, when, status and full length — never the full text. Call read_memory with one id to read it completely. Use it when the findings already in your context are not enough; skip it when they are. Searching is your choice, not a required step.
search_memory.parameters: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"What you are trying to remember, in your own words."},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"Maximum candidates to return (default 4, max 20). A cap, not a promise."},"offset":{"type":"number","description":"Skip this many matches, to browse further in the same query."}},"required":["query"]}

read_memory.description: Read one persisted finding completely, by an id returned from search_memory. Returns the claim, its recorded status together with a plain-language reading of what that status does and does not mean, and the evidence pointers recorded when it was written. Those pointers locate the session events of that moment; after a restart they may no longer resolve, and they never prove the claim still holds. One finding per call — reading several is several decisions.
read_memory.parameters: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"Finding id from search_memory (e.g. \"f-004\")."},"offset":{"type":"number","description":"Character offset into the text, default 0."},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"Characters to return, default 2000, max 6000."}},"required":["id"]}
